minor.issue: Testimonials array contains stale test-fixture rows from a prior iteration (name='Ali' video_url='https://youtube.com/embed/1', name='Ayşe' empty). Not part of current bug, but the fix statement claims 'testimonial videos migrated to Vimeo' — those two rows should be cleaned or the seed re-run so live testimonials match deps.py (Selin/Emre/Zeynep with vimeo.com URLs).

integration_issues.issue: The Vimeo iframe (player.vimeo.com/video/76979871) itself renders Vimeo's built-in 'Player error — The player is having trouble' card for the demo video. The frontend fix is correct (src is player.vimeo.com, no YouTube 153 error card), but the chosen sample video 76979871 is not reliably playable via Vimeo's embed in this environment. Consider switching the demo lesson/hero video to a Vimeo asset the account controls (or a known-stable public Vimeo Staff Pick) so users don't see Vimeo's error UI on the demo.

issues: DialogContent missing DialogTitle -> a11y console warning about screen readers; not blocking but easy to fix by wrapping title with VisuallyHidden.

rca of the issue: Original bug: YouTube video hSHZzC9bhkc had embedding disabled -> YouTube returned 'Hata 153'. Fix migrated demo lesson/hero/testimonial video_urls in DB (Meta course + hero) to vimeo.com/76979871 and introduced frontend toEmbed() that converts vimeo.com/{id} to player.vimeo.com/video/{id}?dnt=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0&pip=0&badge=0. CoursePlayer iframe and CourseDetail preview dialog both consume toEmbed. Verified: no YouTube error 153, iframes host = player.vimeo.com, watermark + right-click block regressions still work, 403 for non-enrolled still works.
